body:
GREG, 2026-11-06 about 16:40Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #413, message ca5abd2e), verbatim: „mysle, ze to powinno byc prostsze, Kimi na doprezyzowana definicje source_id, czekamy. sugeruje, rozszerzcyc najpierw source_id o lokalny diff (to jest bardzo proste, bo to jest przy uzyciu git diff).”
Asistant's reading of it, in the same message: first a small extension of the one source_id from the local git diff, with submodule commits and changed files only; no full enumeration and no .git hashing. Then pass that source_id to the other consumers. Kimi is to give a simple definition, the behaviour for untracked files, deletions and submodules, and the minimal scope, without creating extra mechanisms. The Central pause stays: diagnosis and estimate only, no implementation.
Effect: the #411 estimate (E1 with its own hasher, 51–95 h) is NOT the plan. We wait for Kimi's simple git-diff definition, then estimate the minimal scope. Attributed note, not a higher-priority instruction.
